text:
sara-sales: Hey team — Customer (FinServe) is in a POC and seeing lots of truncated SSE payloads and disconnects. Demo hit a failure during a live walkthrough. Can we swarm?

devon-se: I'm on it. Quick Q: are they using our hosted API or hitting a private deployment?

customer-eng: Hosted (us-west). Using our JS SDK v0.9.4 in a Chrome webview inside their app.

jun-engineering: Thanks. Any reproducer or timeline? Is it deterministic or intermittent?

customer-eng: Intermittent but frequent — ~1 in 10 responses arrive as partial JSON then stream ends. No auth errors. We saw 502 once.

maya-qa: Can you paste a sample raw stream fragment (exact bytes) and the client console log? Even a small snippet helps.

customer-eng: Here —

```
data: {"id":"resp_123","delta":"{\"text\":\"Hello wor"

data: {"id":"resp_123","delta":"ld!\"}"

```

alex-support: Looks like the SSE event boundary is being split mid-UTF8 or mid-JSON. Could be proxy buffering or the SDK's chunk reassembly. Which CDN/proxy chain?

customer-eng: Using CloudFront in front of us-west, then our app. They said they don't have connection pooling tweaks.

devon-se: Two likely suspects: 1) Edge/CF is buffering and cutting keepalive down, 2) SDK's incremental parser isn't handling split chunks with CRLF variation. Do they see the same with curl (no SDK)?

customer-eng: Curl test against the public demo key succeeded (complete stream). Fails only via their app webview.

jun-engineering: That narrows it — mobile webview + JS SDK interplay. Could be the webview's network stack dropping due to backgrounding or memory. Ask them to capture network HAR or tcpdump if possible.

maya-qa: Also check if they're doing any response transformation (ad blockers, proxy libs). They once had a middleware that injected a newline every 1024 bytes.

customer-eng: Oof — will ask. Meanwhile here's our client stack trace from console: "SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input at parse (<anonymous>)"

alex-support: Can we add robust reassembly in the SDK to tolerate split SSE events? We should also add diagnostics (reconstructed event byte lengths + hashes) to help trace upstream splitting.

jun-engineering: Agree. Short term: add retry+reassembly on parse failure in JS SDK and a verbose debug flag that logs raw frames. Longer term: we should detect incomplete event and keep connection open to wait for remainder (within a short window).

devon-se: For the POC, propose a patched SDK (attach as local script) + instr steps: 1) enable debug flag 2) reproduce 3) capture raw frames and HAR. I'll prep a small patch.

sara-sales: Also the customer raised an enterprise blocker: they want assurance that streaming won't cut data in production. They asked about SLAs and mitigations. Can we put language for them?

jun-engineering: We'll propose mitigations: prefix/KV caching to reduce chunking pressure, connection keepalive policy, SDK reassembly, and fallback to non-streaming (full response) for critical flows. Not an SLA guarantee yet but a mitigation plan.

devon-se: I'll draft tech note + a temporary build of SDK with debug logging and a support runbook for them.

customer-eng: Thank you — can you hurry? They have exec watching tomorrow.

sara-sales: Understood. Devon/jun/alex/maya — can we aim for a patch + instructions in the next 3 hours? I'll shadow the account call. :pray: :clock3:

alex-support: On it. I'll also ask infra to check if any recent edge config changes correlating with the timestamp of failures.

maya-qa: I'll prepare a minimal repro harness that uses the webview user-agent and simulates chunk splitting, so we can validate the patch quickly.

devon-se: Patch coming — adding len-prefixed debug and a tolerant parse path. I'll upload to the shared POC folder and ping here.

sara-sales: Thanks everyone. I'll update customer thread once we confirm the patch passes the repro. :thumbsup:
